title: Conditioning Allowance Taken on Out-of-Condition Bushels Before They Earn Under Membership and Patronage Equity
content:
Grain received out of condition carries the cooperative's standard conditioning allowance before it earns anything under Membership and Patronage Equity, since the elevator paid to bring it to grade.

## Which scale tickets are counted

The scale tickets counted are the tickets of the year being reckoned, a ticket falling on the side of the mark its own delivery date lies on: the net bushels on the tickets recorded in the 17 months up to today, less the net bushels on the tickets recorded in the 5 months up to today, so that grain received after the year closed is left to the year it was received in. Those tickets are the scale tickets raised on the member's Grain Marketing Contracts.

The reach that gathers a late settlement back into the year closed gathers no scale ticket with it, since it speaks of settlements alone.

## The allowance

| Tough, damp or wet bushels on the tickets so counted | The volume is taken at |
| --- | --- |
| more than a fifth of the volume settled inside the year | 0.985 of itself |
| standing on those tickets, but not more than a fifth of that volume | 0.995 of itself |
| none | itself, no allowance being carried |

**Where the fifth is measured.** Five times the out-of-condition bushels so counted is set against the volume settled inside the year. Above it, the heavier allowance is taken; at it or below it, and with such bushels standing, the lighter one; with none standing, none at all.

## Boundary cases on hypothetical figures

| Volume settled inside the year | Tough, damp or wet bushels so counted | Five times those bushels | The volume is taken at |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 20000.00 | 4500.00 | 22500.00, above the volume | 0.985 |
| 20000.00 | 4000.00 | 20000.00, exactly the volume and not above it | 0.995 |
| 20000.00 | 150.00 | 750.00, under the volume | 0.995 |
| 20000.00 | none | none | itself |

Bushels that come to exactly a fifth of the volume settled inside the year are not more than a fifth, and the lighter figure of 0.995 is the one taken.

**A ticket received after the close.** A ticket whose delivery date falls in the 5 months up to today is a ticket of the new year, and its bushels are left to the year it was received in, however the settlements of that period are treated.
